Prompts: Extract only the named strip, preserve full fence/wall, gate, towers, flags, greenery and original colors/proportions; add metallic silver (palisade) or metallic gold (stone) outside silhouette outline with highlights/reflections, preserve dark interior outlines, transparent background, no text, shadow or glow.
